sloka: अनिःश्वसन्तं युक्तं तं सशक्राः साप्सरोगणाः ।देवाः सर्षिगणाः सर्वे पुष्पैरभ्यकिरंस्तदा ।। ७.१०६.१६ ॥
transliteration: aniḥśvasantaṁ yuktaṁ taṁ saśakrāḥ sāpsarogaṇāḥ ।devāḥ sarṣigaṇāḥ sarve puṣpairabhyakiraṁstadā ।। 7.106.16 ॥

translations.english: Then, all the gods, along with Indra, groups of Apsaras, and groups of sages, showered flowers upon him (Lakshmana), who was absorbed (in his divine form) and had ceased breathing.
